newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ACT not a potential coalition partner -NZ's Bolger.
newsitem.headline: ACT not a potential coalition partner -NZ's Bolger.

text.p: New Zealand caretaker Prime Minister Jim Bolger said on Wednesday that National and New Zealand First were not negotiating to include the radical free-market ACT Party in a coalition.
"Let me be quite clear, we are not talking about bringing ACT into a coalition," Bolger told reporters before informal talks with NZ First.
"I talked to (ACT leader) Richard Prebble the other day but that was just having a chat," Bolger said.

Wellington's Dominion newspaper reported earlier on Wednesday that caretaker Deputy Prime Minister Don McKinnon was to meet with ACT's caucus this afternoon to discuss the relationship between ACT and National.
But Bolger said McKinnon would simply host informal drinks with both caucuses tonight.
